sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球排名前列的大学，致力于解决世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境方面最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州乃至全球范围内开展合作与创新，以寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是该大学促进所有生物生活质量这一使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: It's a big, majestic building on Nathan Phillips Square.
sentences.zh: 那是一座位于内森·菲利普斯广场的宏伟建筑。

sentences.en: And this is my friend Sean Cole in Toronto, Ontario.
sentences.zh: 这位是我的朋友肖恩·科尔，他在安大略省多伦多市。

sentences.en: New City Hall.
sentences.zh: 新市政厅。

sentences.en: It's formed totally of concrete.
sentences.zh: 它完全由混凝土构成。

sentences.en: There are these two towers that sort of curve like hands cupped around a clamshell.
sentences.zh: 它有两座塔楼，弯曲的形状就像双手合拢捧着一个蛤蜊壳。

sentences.en: So this was a big deal.
sentences.zh: 所以这在当时是一件大事。

sentences.en: When it opened in 1965.
sentences.zh: 当它在1965年落成时。

sentences.en: The first modern concrete civic building for Toronto inserted very prominently into the Victorian fabric.
sentences.zh: 这是多伦多第一座现代混凝土市政建筑，非常显眼地插入了维多利亚时代的建筑群中。

sentences.en: Masha Kelman's used to work in the city planning office in the East Tower on floor 19.
sentences.zh: 玛莎·凯尔曼曾在那座东塔的19楼城市规划办公室工作。

sentences.en: She's an architect.
sentences.zh: 她是一位建筑师。

sentences.en: The building really explored and exploited the possibilities of concrete.
sentences.zh: 这座建筑真正探索并利用了混凝土的可能性。

sentences.en: Everything was about concrete in Toronto back then.
sentences.zh: 那时多伦多的一切都与混凝土有关。

sentences.en: The play of opacity versus transparency in everything.
sentences.zh: 一切都在玩转不透明与透明的对比。

sentences.en: So the furniture really picked up on that.
sentences.zh: 所以家具也确实呼应了这一点。

sentences.en: Yes, even the office furniture inside City Hall was made in part of concrete.
sentences.zh: 是的，甚至市政厅内部的办公家具部分也是用混凝土制成的。

sentences.en: But let's back up.
sentences.zh: 但让我们回顾一下。

sentences.en: In the 50s, Toronto decided that it needed a new City Hall.
sentences.zh: 50年代，多伦多决定需要一座新的市政厅。

sentences.en: So there was an international competition.
sentences.zh: 于是举行了一场国际竞赛。

sentences.en: And in 58, there was a design selected by Finnish architect Vilja Ravel.
sentences.zh: 1958年，芬兰建筑师维尔乔·雷维尔的设计方案入选。

sentences.en: But he wasn't satisfied with simply designing one of the most prominent buildings the city had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 但他并不满足于仅仅设计这座城市有史以来最显眼的建筑之一。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Ravel, you know, proposed that he was also going to design the furniture.
sentences.zh: 雷维尔提出他还要负责设计家具。

sentences.en: He wanted to design the furniture.
sentences.zh: 他想设计这些家具。

sentences.en: He had a vision.
sentences.zh: 他有自己的愿景。

sentences.en: But it wasn't to be.
sentences.zh: 但事与愿违。

sentences.en: The decision that City Hall made was to commission the furniture through a second competition.
sentences.zh: 市政厅最终决定通过第二次竞赛来委托家具设计。

sentences.en: So Ravel was very disappointed.
sentences.zh: 所以雷维尔非常失望。

sentences.en: It was very dramatic.
sentences.zh: 这非常戏剧化。

sentences.en: He called it the biggest disappointment of his life.
sentences.zh: 他称这是他一生中最大的失望。

sentences.en: And he subsequently passed away.
sentences.zh: 随后他便去世了。

sentences.en: City Hall felt bad.
sentences.zh: 市政厅感到很愧疚。

sentences.en: Or at leaSt...
sentences.zh: 或者至少……

sentences.en: They felt the weight of the responsibility to award the competition to someone who really understood and captured the spirit of the building.
sentences.zh: 他们感到有责任将竞赛授予一个真正理解并捕捉到建筑精神的人。

sentences.en: So they gave it to a company called Knoll International.
sentences.zh: 于是他们把它交给了诺尔国际公司。

sentences.en: And it was the only design that used concrete?
sentences.zh: 那是唯一使用混凝土的设计吗？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Desks, coffee tables, cabinets.
sentences.zh: 书桌、咖啡桌、柜子。

sentences.en: They all had concrete legs.
sentences.zh: 它们都有混凝土桌腿。

sentences.en: The mayor's desk was this sleek concrete and polished wood statement.
sentences.zh: 市长的办公桌是一个由混凝土和抛光木材构成的时尚宣言。

sentences.en: And all of this was really expensive.
sentences.zh: 而且所有这些都非常昂贵。

sentences.en: And there was immediate public outcry about this furniture.
sentences.zh: 公众对这些家具立即产生了强烈的抗议。

sentences.en: Particularly from the people who were actually using it.
sentences.zh: 特别是那些真正使用它们的人。

sentences.en: There were complaints that the desks were wobbly and that when secretaries typed on them, they weren't sturdy.
sentences.zh: 有人抱怨桌子摇晃，秘书在上面打字时桌子不稳。

sentences.en: But the legs are concrete.
sentences.zh: 但桌腿是混凝土做的啊。

sentences.en: How could it not be sturdy?
sentences.zh: 怎么会不稳呢？

sentences.en: It's hard to imagine, yeah.
sentences.zh: 确实很难想象。

sentences.en: Toronto Star.
sentences.zh: 《多伦多星报》。

sentences.en: Furniture rouse on again.
sentences.zh: 家具风波再起。

sentences.en: And we have in our research file many articles from that time with all kinds of really interesting headlines.
sentences.zh: 我们在研究档案中找到了许多当时的报道，标题都非常有趣。

sentences.en: Globe and Mail.
sentences.zh: 《环球邮报》。

sentences.en: Well, wobbly desks at City Hall sparked new furniture controversy.
sentences.zh: 市政厅摇晃的办公桌引发了新的家具争议。

sentences.en: Various officials in City Hall were fighting over it.
sentences.zh: 市政厅的各级官员为此争论不休。

sentences.en: There was even one that talked about somebody quitting.
sentences.zh: 甚至有一篇报道提到有人因此辞职。

sentences.en: Krusty George Bell went out as coordinator today after a blazing row with border control over secretaries' desks.
sentences.zh: 克拉斯蒂·乔治·贝尔今天辞去了协调员的职务，此前他因秘书办公桌的问题与边境管制部门发生了激烈的争吵。

sentences.en: This was the 60s and hemlines were starting to get shorter.
sentences.zh: 那是60年代，裙摆开始变短了。

sentences.en: And there was nothing to shield the secretary's knees.
sentences.zh: 而且没有任何东西可以遮挡秘书的膝盖。

sentences.en: And the new desks had no drawers.
sentences.zh: 新桌子也没有抽屉。

sentences.en: And they weren't big enough.
sentences.zh: 而且不够大。

sentences.en: But Masha Kelman has sat at that furniture.
sentences.zh: 但玛莎·凯尔曼曾坐过那种家具。

sentences.en: She used to work at one of those desks.
sentences.zh: 她以前就在其中一张桌子上工作过。

sentences.en: And it didn't wobble.
sentences.zh: 它并不摇晃。

sentences.en: When she said...
sentences.zh: 当她说……

sentences.en: It's hard to imagine, yeah.
sentences.zh: 确实很难想象。

sentences.en: It was because some of the complaints make no sense to her.
sentences.zh: 那是因为有些抱怨在她看来毫无道理。

sentences.en: And she has a theory.
sentences.zh: 她有一个理论。

sentences.en: Once City Hall was up, perhaps it was quite uncomfortable for people to internalize that this is really what they had chosen.
sentences.zh: 一旦市政厅建成，人们可能很难接受这就是他们真正选择的结果。

sentences.en: And perhaps there was a kind of anxiety about this new modernism and this new concrete that we were inserting into our traditional city.
sentences.zh: 也许对于这种插入传统城市的新现代主义和新混凝土建筑，人们产生了一种焦虑感。

sentences.en: So perhaps the furniture, which was kind of mimetic of the building...
sentences.zh: 所以，这种模仿建筑风格的家具……

sentences.en: Mimetic.
sentences.zh: 模仿。

sentences.en: Relating to characteristic of or exhibiting mimicry.
sentences.zh: 与模仿有关、具有模仿特征或表现出模仿行为。

sentences.en: Okay, so perhaps the furniture, which was mimetic of the building...
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以这种模仿建筑风格的家具……

sentences.en: Really served as an outlet for that anxiety.
sentences.zh: 实际上成了这种焦虑的宣泄口。

sentences.en: And perhaps this is why the controversy didn't seem to make so much sense.
sentences.zh: 也许这就是为什么这些争议看起来那么没道理。

sentences.en: Later, the complaint was that it was difficult to move and so on.
sentences.zh: 后来，抱怨变成了移动困难等等。

sentences.en: And so, of course, you know, as City Hall began to update itself over the years, the furniture, since it was not valued, it was lost just simply through replacement.
sentences.zh: 当然，随着市政厅多年来的不断更新，这些家具因为不被重视，在更换过程中被简单地淘汰了。

sentences.en: It was actually thrown away.
sentences.zh: 它们实际上被扔掉了。

sentences.en: But not all of it.
sentences.zh: 但并非全部。

sentences.en: It's kind of like a hunt in here, a treasure hunt looking for them.
sentences.zh: 在这里寻找它们就像一场寻宝游戏。

sentences.en: But they are here.
sentences.zh: 但它们确实在这里。

sentences.en: In the late 80s, the city's director of urban design at the time saw what was happening.
sentences.zh: 80年代末，当时城市的城市设计总监看到了正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: This is a very subtle one.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常微妙的细节。

sentences.en: And put the word out to the rest of City Hall.
sentences.zh: 他向市政厅的其他部门传达了消息。

sentences.en: If you're replacing your concrete furniture, he said, send it up to floor 19.
sentences.zh: 他说，如果你要更换混凝土家具，就把它们送到19楼。

sentences.en: We like it.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢它们。

sentences.en: Which is why today, whatever does remain is still housed in the urban design offices, which are within the city planning department.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么今天剩下的家具仍然存放在城市规划部门内的城市设计办公室里。

sentences.en: There's a bit of it scattered elsewhere, too.
sentences.zh: 还有一些散落在其他地方。

sentences.en: The mayor still sits at a concrete desk.
sentences.zh: 市长仍然坐在混凝土办公桌前。

sentences.en: But mostly, floor 19 is the Florida of retired concrete furniture.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，19楼是退休混凝土家具的“佛罗里达”。

sentences.en: You wouldn't notice the concrete unless you really squat down on the floor.
sentences.zh: 除非你真的蹲在地上，否则你不会注意到混凝土。

sentences.en: The concrete legs are curved and smooth.
sentences.zh: 混凝土桌腿是弯曲且光滑的。

sentences.en: The cabinetry's a little worse for wear.
sentences.zh: 柜子有点磨损了。

sentences.en: It's kind of furniture only an urban designer could love.
sentences.zh: 这大概是只有城市设计师才会喜欢的家具。

sentences.en: People like Robert Friedman, who runs the urban planning office now.
sentences.zh: 比如现在负责城市规划办公室的罗伯特·弗里德曼。

sentences.en: There are certain aspects of it that aren't that practical.
sentences.zh: 它确实有一些不太实用的方面。

sentences.en: It's really heavy.
sentences.zh: 它太重了。

sentences.en: If you want to rearrange your office, you need to call a team of people in to help you do it.
sentences.zh: 如果你想重新布置办公室，你需要叫一队人来帮你。

sentences.en: And I think most of the planners and urban designers, right, in 19, it's part of your training, right?
sentences.zh: 我想19楼的大多数规划师和城市设计师，这都是你们培训的一部分，对吧？

sentences.en: You're exposed to the different eras of design.
sentences.zh: 你们接触过不同时代的设计。

sentences.en: So I think there's an appreciation among our staff that may not exist among other divisions in the city.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们的员工对它有一种欣赏，这在城市其他部门可能并不存在。

sentences.en: Look at this bench.
sentences.zh: 看看这个长凳。

sentences.en: Though I have to say, the furniture really grew on me.
sentences.zh: 虽然我不得不说，这家具确实让我越看越喜欢。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That is actually very pretty.
sentences.zh: 它其实非常漂亮。

sentences.en: And I found myself sort of rooting for its survival, which is exactly what Masha Kalman's wants me to do.
sentences.zh: 我发现自己开始支持它留存下来，这正是玛莎·凯尔曼希望我做的。

sentences.en: So the hope is that its actual value as a rather important piece of, you know, uniquely Canadian furniture design will be recognized and that it will receive the, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以希望它作为一件独特的加拿大家具设计，其真正的价值能得到认可，并能获得……

sentences.en: the restoration and the protection that it deserves.
sentences.zh: 它应得的修复和保护。

sentences.en: Do you miss it?
sentences.zh: 你会想念它吗？

sentences.en: Um, no.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不会。

sentences.en: This episode of 99% Invisible was produced by Sean Cole and me, Roman Mars, with support from Lunar, making a difference with creativity.
sentences.zh: 本期《99%隐形》由肖恩·科尔和我罗曼·马尔斯制作，并得到了 Lunar 的支持，用创意创造改变。

sentences.en: I think life is much bigger than my old office desk, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我觉得生活比我旧的办公桌重要得多。

sentences.en: It's a project of KALW, the American Institute of Architects San Francisco, and the Center for Architecture and Design.
sentences.zh: 这是 KALW、美国建筑师协会旧金山分会以及建筑与设计中心的一个项目。

sentences.en: It's a nice desk, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，这确实是一张好桌子。

sentences.en: I agreed.
sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.en: To find out more, go to 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 99percentinvisible.org。
